claims.exact_statement: Redondo et al. report a subset of TLR4-dependent macrophage genes with clone-level expression variability after approximately 25 cell divisions and report density-reinforced CD36, transient IL1beta, and a relationship between CD36-high clones and Listeria susceptibility.
assumptions: claim is limited to the immortalised murine macrophage model and experimental conditions in the source
source is bioRxiv version 1 posted 2026-06-19 and marked not peer reviewed
claims.novelty_boundary: This is an existing preprint's experimental claim, not a result of this lane and not a general law of innate immunity.
costs: source used RNA-seq, high-content immunostaining, clone expansion, and infection assays
full public external archive is about 2.5 GB and was not downloaded
claims.falsifier: Independent reproduction under matched macrophage, ligand, clone-expansion, and image-analysis conditions fails to recover the reported state persistence or CD36/infection association.
claims.next_gate: Reproduce from accessible raw or processed inputs and test density against time and clone-competence controls on held-out clones.

claims.exact_statement: For equal-growth OFF/ON branching with conditional OFF-to-ON rate a(N(t)), ON-to-OFF rate b, and a deterministic total-size path, the ON-fraction mean p satisfies p'=a(N)(1-p)-bp=r(q-p), where q=a/(a+b) and r=a+b. If q is nondecreasing and p(0)<=q(0), then p(t)<=q(t); the exact gap equals exp(-integral_0^t r)*(q(0)-p(0)) plus the exponentially weighted integral of q'.
assumptions: equal per-cell birth rates in both states
births inherit the parent's state and no state-dependent death
conditional on N(t), switching hazards are a(N(t)) and b
mean fraction rather than individual stochastic trajectory
q is nondecreasing for the inequality
claims.status: conditional derivation; internally reconstructed standard model
claims.novelty_boundary: A routine conditional model consequence and diagnostic of instantaneous-equilibrium plots; not a new biological theorem or evidence that local density changes switching.
costs: requires the measured or modeled size path and switching rates
numerical examples use a deterministic growth approximation and do not reproduce the stochastic clone ensemble
claims.falsifier: Under the stated model and assumptions, an exact generator calculation gives a different conditional mean equation or lag identity.
claims.next_gate: Use the identity only as a model check inside a held-out density/time experiment.

claims.exact_statement: The public rate-estimation Rmd uses the CD36 Mock pair-count table for its odds ratio but sets FractionON to the unweighted mean of a separate clone-level workbook. The original two small workbooks give a clamped clone mean of 0.216803 across 1,108 rows and a same-pair marginal of 0.134276 across 566 Mock pairs. Holding the pooled pair OR 74.3684 fixed, the stated formula shifts k_on+k_off from 0.015706 to 0.019544 h^-1 when the pair marginal is used.
assumptions: the Rmd is intended to represent the manuscript's rate-estimation workflow
the released Rmd and selectively extracted workbook version correspond to the calculation path being audited
the model f_ON parameter should equal the pair-cohort marginal; if the authors intended a different clone-level estimand, a mapping must be supplied
claims.status: source-code/workbook observation plus finite conditional re-inversion; not a full paper-fit reproduction
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a released-workflow interface audit. It does not prove the final paper parameter estimates were generated by this exact script version and does not refute the source biology.
costs: two small workbooks were selectively fetched via HTTP ranges and CRC-checked
no full bootstrap/optimizer or image-level replay; the remaining archive is about 2.5 GB
claims.falsifier: A corrected or superseding workflow shows the clone-level fraction is the intended estimand and supplies a validated mapping from it to the same pair-cohort marginal, with unchanged uncertainty-aware rates.
claims.next_gate: Resolve f_ON from the same cohort or document a validated bridge; jointly bootstrap paired state counts before interpreting the rates.

claims.exact_statement: No new immune-dynamics scientific advance has been established. The strongest source-backed result is a conditional audit of the released rate workflow and the distance-defined pair interface; a decisive follow-up resolves the same-cohort ON marginal, tracks actual sisters, and independently varies local density and elapsed time with equally informed controls.
assumptions: scope is this bounded source/model audit
the decisive design uses matched acquisition, observation likelihood, clone effects, and held-out evaluation across candidate models
claims.status: lane verdict and proposed falsifiable gate
claims.novelty_boundary: An internal source-code/data audit and proposed experiment are not an executed biological test or a discovery.
costs: clone derivation, factorial wells, live or repeated imaging, segmentation, viability and morphology measurement, and held-out replication
exact resource estimates require a power analysis from accessible clone-level data
claims.falsifier: The density model has no reproducible held-out predictive gain after matching elapsed time, clone, plate, viability, and morphology, or clock-only effects dominate at matched density.
claims.next_gate: Resolve f_ON from the pair cohort, track true sisters and matched neighbors, then test density/time effects on held-out clones and plates.

claims.exact_statement: If a fraction rho of proximity-selected pairs are true sisters and the rest are conditionally independent neighbors with the same ON marginal f, then u_obs=rho*u_s+(1-rho)*f*(1-f), where u is either mixed-pair orientation. The observed odds ratio lies between 1 and the true-sister odds ratio. Under the source sister-pair switching model, fitting the observed odds ratio as if every pair were a sister therefore overestimates m=k_on+k_off and underestimates the relaxation time 1/m; unknown rho prevents point-identification.
assumptions: exchangeable binary ON/OFF pair states with the same marginal f in sister and background pairs
the non-sister background is conditionally independent after matching clone, plate, time, and local density
true sisters have nonnegative state association
the source pair-OR-to-rate formula and measured growth rate lambda apply to true sister pairs
the proximity pair rule may contain non-sisters; its actual purity rho is unmeasured in the inspected Methods
claims.status: conditional measurement-bias derivation; internally reconstructed from the preprint acquisition and model
claims.novelty_boundary: Barcode-based sister-state tracing is established prior art (for example ReSisTrace 2024). This is a conditional, macrophage-workflow-specific sensitivity; it does not show any source pair was misclassified or that the experimental observations are false.
costs: requires lineage tracking through division to estimate proximity-rule positive predictive value
requires matched-distance unrelated neighbors to measure background pair association
full lineage imaging duration, cadence, illumination, ambiguous tracking, and plate costs must be charged
claims.falsifier: Track-verified and proximity-selected pair tables agree within uncertainty after matching the local-background distribution, and the corrected transition-rate estimate is unchanged.
claims.next_gate: Track a subset of pairs through division, apply the original proximity rule to the same fields, and jointly fit the tracked-sister, proximity-candidate, and matched-neighbor 2x2 tables.

overall_verdict: No new biological law or scientific discovery established. The strongest concrete result is a source-backed audit of the released CD36 rate workflow: its OR comes from pair counts while its FractionON comes from separate clone-level data, and the same-pair marginal changes the conditional inferred total switching rate by 24.4%. Unknown pair purity adds a second conditional measurement issue. Treat both as an audit lead until the intended f_ON estimand, same-cohort joint uncertainty, and true-lineage controls are resolved. The C11 immune task had no surviving artifacts and was restored only from the parent mandate.
